_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: No visible breaker (ETF/stablecoin dead, funding crowded, CVD cancelled by liquidity at 1); coil statistics make HOLD the skilled default until a volume-backed range break.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Anxiety; narrative silent on BTC phase and only implies risk-off in metals, not a shared directional call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound with funding near 0.01% and fear holding in the 30s without volume expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: Volume-backed range break with ETF/CVD follow-through lifting fear out of the 30s, or funding flipping negative on a liquidation through support
